newsitem.title: ITALY: Britain to send observers to Albanian elections.
newsitem.headline: Britain to send observers to Albanian elections.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook said on Tuesday London would send 45 observers to help monitor Albanian elections later this month.
Cook, in Rome for talks with his counterpart Lamberto Dini, said they would join eight British observers already in Albania, and that 15 would be members of parliament from all parties.
He said they would work with the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe, whose envoy Franz Vranitzky has played a key mediation role in preparing for the elections.
Cook praised Italy's "active role to defuse the crisis" after violence swept the Balkan country in March following the collapse of shady pyramid investment schemes.
Italy is leading a multinational security force which Dini said he did not anticipate would remain in Albania much beyond the elections, scheduled for June 29.
